quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on defensive lapses and the team's slow-paced offense
quotes.excerpt: It was a slower-paced game, and the way that they switch everything, that naturally slows teams down.
quotes.quote: It was a slower-paced game, and the way that they switch everything, that naturally slows teams down offensively, which is why we scored what we scored. I think the more we move the ball, the more we play off each other when teams are switching, it's going to help us. But it was a low-scoring game because of how they muck things up defensively. I felt like their players were too comfortable getting to their spots, especially early on, and then Randle especially got going. He was comfortable, and he obviously won them the game.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro on the defensive lapses against Julius Randle: I felt like their players were too comfortable getting to their spots, especially early on, and then Randle especially got going. He was comfortable, and he obviously won them the game.

structured.context: Tyler Herro analyzes the team's offensive struggles against a switching defense and highlights the impact of Julius Randle's performance.
